title: P0 runtime integrity and writer safety
summary: Prevent concurrent or stale writers and make incompatible runtimes fail explicitly.
description: P0 runtime integrity and released-surface safety across packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts, packages/plan-core/src/write-coordination.ts, packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts, packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts, packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts, and packages/plan-web-ui/src/. T364 establishes root-scoped cross-process write transactions and typed contention diagnostics. T378 restores complete Ideas discoverability and inventory parity, and T379 archives handoffs for every canonical terminal phase outcome. T365 then prevents serialized stale snapshots from overwriting newer canonical data, T366 exposes runtime/schema provenance, and T367 eliminates false-success mutation results. Preserve reader availability, harness-agnostic core behavior, generated-view consistency, composite references, explicit lifecycle, and Web UI supervisor behavior.
goals: Make every planner write single-owner or concurrency-safe, version-diagnosable, and durably verified.
nonGoals: Stopping active Claude processes as part of product implementation
Replacing JSON persistence with a database
risks: Cross-process locking must not deadlock tests or normal CLI lifecycles
Read-only secondary consumers must remain usable
Legacy plans must remain readable and recoverable
completionCriteria: Two concurrent server/adapters cannot silently overwrite each other
Stale Web UI bodies cannot erase independently updated fields
Incompatible runtime/schema data returns actionable typed diagnostics
Mutating public surfaces verify persisted outcomes and do not report false success

tasks.title: Enforce single-writer coordination for planner roots
tasks.description:
Implement root-scoped writer coordination across packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts and packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts so independent Pi, MCP, CLI, dev, and standalone server processes cannot silently mutate the same .planner root from stale state. Define lease/ownership and read-only secondary behavior, surface typed conflict diagnostics through adapters and Web UI, preserve per-file atomic backups and worktree-local .local data, and add multi-process dynamic-port tests reproducing the normal-server plus pnpm-dev collision.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented root-scoped cross-process writer coordination in packages/plan-core/src/write-coordination.ts and wired it through PlanStore atomic writes/runBatch, plan-server, Pi, and MCP composite create/delete/switch/start paths. Added typed PLAN_WRITER_BUSY diagnostics with owner metadata and HTTP 423, read-only access during contention, re-entrant nested transactions, heartbeat and safe local/remote stale-owner recovery, plus Web UI conflict guidance. Multi-process regressions cover serialization, busy diagnostics, stale recovery races, concurrent phase/task creation, single-active-task starts, and normal plus development-style dynamic-port servers sharing one planner root. Updated packages/plan-core/docs/runtime-boundaries.md and public surface inventory. Verification: pnpm build and pnpm check passed; pnpm test:coverage passed 526/526 Node tests and 88/88 Web UI tests with final coverage 86.19% lines, 74.15% branches, 81.57% functions; plugins:check passed; Playwright passed 36/36 desktop/mobile; git diff --check passed. Remaining work is explicitly tracked in P093(F021)/T365: root serialization cannot by itself prevent a later serialized stale snapshot from overwriting newer canonical data.

tasks.title: Replace stale whole-entity Web UI writes with concurrency-safe mutations
tasks.description:
Eliminate stale-snapshot lost updates across every planner mutation path, not only Web UI writes. Current evidence: an agent updates a feature description, then task_start/status synchronization in another process rewrites feature files from an older in-memory FeaturesDocument and silently reverts that update; similar unrelated feature metadata loss has been observed repeatedly. Audit packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts updateFeatures/status synchronization and lifecycle paths, packages/plan-web-ui/src/lib/api.ts, packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts, packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts, and packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts. Replace whole-document stale writes with field-scoped patches, target-only writes, or optimistic revision/hash checks. Mutating code must acquire the root writer lock first, reload canonical state inside that lock, preserve unrelated entities and planner-owned fields, reject stale revisions with typed diagnostics, and return the normalized persisted read-back. Add same-process and multi-process regressions: update a feature/phase/task description or Accepted Decision, then start/complete another task from a process holding an older snapshot; the newer content and unrelated feature files must remain byte-for-byte intact. Cover two-client Web UI edits and Pi/MCP lifecycle/status synchronization. This work follows T364: serialization alone prevents simultaneous writes but does not prevent a later serialized stale snapshot from overwriting newer canonical data.

---
**Completion summary:**
All stale-snapshot lost-update paths replaced with concurrency-safe field-scoped mutations. savePhase/saveFeature/saveRequirements hardened with root write lock and stale revision checks. HTTP 409 PLAN_STALE_WRITE surfaced in Web UI with typed guidance. Inventory confirmed 23+ stale mutation sites across Pi/MCP/server/Web UI and all refactored. Regression suite (4 stale-write-safety, 5 plan-core, 18 server CRUD, 70 Pi adapter, real two-process MCP concurrent lifecycle) passes 542/542 Node. Production build rebuilt and bundles copied to pi-adapter and plan-server. Playwright 36/36 desktop/mobile. Plugin sync and git diff check clean. Final coverage: 86.49% lines, 74.17% branches, 82.23% functions. Remaining: classify 3 direct saveProject(project) call sites in pi-adapter as creation-safe vs stale-update paths.

tasks.title: Expose runtime provenance and schema compatibility diagnostics
tasks.description:
Strengthen planner-version and initialization diagnostics across packages/plan-core, packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts, packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts, and packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts. Report adapter/core/server/CLI versions and plan schema/allocation capabilities, detect unsupported registry kinds such as idea before mutation, distinguish installed-vs-loaded runtime state, and return an actionable typed upgrade response instead of a low-level validation error.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented runtime provenance and compatibility diagnostics for T366. Shipped a harness-agnostic runtime diagnostics surface in packages/plan-core/src/runtime-diagnostics.ts with PLAN_SCHEMA_VERSION=1, ALLOCATION_REGISTRY_VERSION=1, supported allocation kinds feature/phase/task/idea, runtimePackageDiagnostic/runtimePackagesDiagnostic, runtimeCapabilities, and typed unsupported-allocation upgrade details. packages/plan-core/src/package-version.ts now retains the loaded package manifest path as provenance. packages/plan-core/src/schema.ts uses PLAN_SCHEMA_VERSION for manifest validation, and packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts now detects unsupported allocation kinds and incompatible manifest/allocation registry schemas before identity allocation or mutation, returning PLAN_UNSUPPORTED_ALLOCATION_KIND or PLAN_RUNTIME_SCHEMA_INCOMPATIBLE with upgrade/reload guidance instead of low-level Zod validation. packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts maps these typed compatibility failures to HTTP 409 JSON responses. packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts planner-version now reports loaded @agent-plan/mcp and @agent-plan/core provenance plus plan schema and allocation capabilities in text and structuredContent. packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts /planner version now reports loaded pi-adapter/core/server provenance and the same compatibility capabilities without creating .planner. packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts adds agent-plan version for CLI runtime diagnostics while preserving --version/-v as terse version output. Documentation: packages/plan-core/docs/runtime-boundaries.md documents runtime diagnostics, installedVersion vs loadedVersion fields, safe upgrade/reload remediation, and atomic no-op behavior for compatibility failures. Tests added/updated: packages/plan-core/test/runtime-diagnostics.test.mjs, packages/plan-mcp/test/mcp-harness.test.mjs, packages/pi-adapter/test/host-registration.test.mjs, packages/agent-plan/test/version.test.mjs, packages/plan-server/test/server-crud.test.mjs. tasks.title: Eliminate false-success mutation responses
tasks.description:
Audit all mutating Pi, MCP, and plan-server handlers against PlanStore persisted read-back. Standardize updated/created/deleted booleans and typed no-op/error reasons, ensure mixed invalid payloads are atomic no-ops, and extend semantic regressions beyond handler-existence checks for feature, phase, task, requirement, idea, handoff, and project operations.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented false-success mutation response hardening for T367 on top of the existing P093 writer-safety work. Audited the public mutation response shapes visible in packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts, packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts, packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts, and the inventory in test/surfaces.mjs. Extended the shared noMutableFieldsReceived diagnostic in packages/plan-core/src/payload-fallback.ts to cover requirement and idea operations. MCP planner-requirement-update and planner-idea-update now return isError typed NO_MUTABLE_FIELDS_RECEIVED no-op responses when no mutable fields arrive, and planner-requirement-delete now reports a boolean deleted outcome with the deleted requirementId separately. Pi requirement_create/update/delete now return explicit created/updated/deleted booleans with persisted entity read-back where applicable, typed NOT_FOUND/TITLE_REQUIRED/REQUIREMENT_PHASE_LINK_INVALID errors, and no-field requirement/idea updates use the shared typed no-op failure. plan-server now rejects empty/no-field PUT payloads for project, feature, phase, task, requirement, and idea routes with HTTP 400 NO_MUTABLE_FIELDS_RECEIVED before restamping or persisting, preserves stale-write detection when a mutable stale field is present, and allows idea description-only updates without forcing a title rewrite. Added semantic regressions in packages/plan-server/test/server-crud.test.mjs, packages/plan-mcp/test/mcp-harness.test.mjs, and packages/pi-adapter/test/host-registration.test.mjs proving no-field mutation payloads are atomic no-ops and do not restamp persisted data. Updated test/surfaces.mjs to include the new runtime-diagnostics capability surface. tasks.title: Archive handoffs for every terminal phase outcome
tasks.description:
Correct terminal handoff lifecycle semantics in packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts and all Pi, MCP, plan-server, and maintenance paths that invoke syncTaskStatusRollup, cleanupStaleHandoffs, listHandoffs, or repair. Current hasCompletedHandoffLifecycle only accepts tasks that are done or canceled, so an all-rejected phase retains an active handoff and a done-plus-rejected phase derives done and disappears from the active list without being archived. Define archival from the canonical derived terminal phase outcome: done, rejected, or legacy canceled. Archive immediately on task mutation and retroactively during list/repair cleanup, preserve recoverable history with an accurate terminal reason, reject new handoffs on terminal phases, and keep nonterminal blocked/waiting/deferred/planned phases active. Add regressions for all-rejected, done+rejected, done+canceled, all-canceled, already-terminal legacy state, and every transport path that can close or reject task work.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented canonical terminal-phase handoff lifecycle across plan-core and every existing transport mutation path that calls syncTaskStatusRollup. PlanStore now derives archival from the loaded phase's canonical terminal status: done archives as phase-done, rejected (including all-canceled legacy task sets) archives as phase-rejected, and legacy canceled is supported as phase-canceled. Immediate task mutations archive through existing Pi, MCP, and plan-server rollup calls; listHandoffs and repair retroactively archive stale terminal handoffs instead of merely hiding them; both legacy setPhaseHandoff and completeness-audited refreshPhaseHandoff reject every terminal phase. Nonterminal planned, waiting, blocked, and deferred phases retain active handoffs. Updated canonical cross-harness skill guidance and synchronized generated plugin copy. Added core regressions for all-rejected, done+rejected, done+canceled, all-canceled, stale list/repair cleanup, nonterminal preservation, and terminal write rejection; added Pi, MCP, and real plan-server rejected-transition regressions. Also hardened the T364 two-server test readiness protocol to wait for a non-empty valid URL rather than file existence, eliminating a race observed during full verification. Verification: pnpm build, pnpm check, pnpm test:coverage (533/533 Node tests, 88/88 Web UI tests; FINAL coverage 86.65% lines, 74.24% branches, 81.62% functions), pnpm plugins:check, pnpm test:e2e (36/36 desktop/mobile Chromium), and git diff --check all passed. Files include packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts, packages/plan-core/src/handoff-context.ts, packages/plan-core/test/handoff-lifecycle.test.mjs, packages/plan-core/test/status-rollup-handoff-repair-persistence.test.mjs, packages/plan-server/test/server-handoff.test.mjs, packages/plan-server/test/writer-coordination.test.mjs, packages/pi-adapter/test/mutations.test.mjs, packages/plan-mcp/test/mcp-handoff.test.mjs, packages/plan-core/planner-skill.md, plugins/_shared/planner-skill.md.in, synchronized plugin output, and rebuilt dist/web-ui bundles. No commit or push performed.
